20% of the 20 students enrolled in contemporary dance, which is 4 students. The remaining 16 students represent 80% of the class. Then, 25% of those remaining enrolled in jazz dance, which is 4 students (25% of 16). The rest, 12 students, enrolled in hip-hop dance. As a percentage of the entire class, that is (12/20) × 100% = 60%.

Answer: 60%
